text:
Anu: Quick design question — are we comfortable replacing the sample-rate dropdown with a compact slider + quick-presets?
Mike: I like the idea for speed, but worried about discoverability of exact rates (1%, 5%, 10%).
Jess: Can we show numeric ticks when you hover/focus the slider? that lets keyboard users see exact values.
Anu: Yeah hover tooltip + a11y text for screen readers. example microcopy: "Showing a sampled view (approx. X% of requests) — use presets for common sizes." Thoughts?
Sam: Copy sounds ok but avoid "approx" — customers ask about exactness. maybe: "Showing a representative sample (X% of requests)"
Olga: Also we need to clarify what "representative" means. add small help link: "How sampling works" which expands inline with a short blurb + link to docs.
Jess: On interaction: keyboard should allow arrow keys +/-1% and PageUp/PageDown jump to presets. aria-live region announces changes.
Mike: For the p95 chart: if sample rate < 5% should we show a faint dashed p95 ghost line warning that metric may be noisy? accessibility: make sure color + pattern combo works for colorblind.
Anu: Good call. proposed rule: <5% dashed with a tooltip: "Low sample rate — p95 may be unstable." allow toggle to hide ghost lines.
DesignBot: Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.test/uploads/ui/sampler_v2.png (shows slider, three presets, help link placement).
Sam: Placement nit — currently slider sits between timepicker and heatmap controls. Suggest moving it next to the heatmap density control so it's clearly scope-limited.
Olga: Agree. Also adjust label to read: "Sampling (view only)" to reduce concern about data loss.
Jess: Accessibility nit: presets need reachable targets (min 44px) and focus outline. Also ensure presets are buttons not links.
Mike: Copy suggestion for tooltip: "Sampling reduces rendered points to speed up charts. Use presets for quick toggles or the slider for fine-grain control." shorter: "Reduces points to speed charts; choose a preset or fine-tune the slider."
Anu: Let's land on: 1) move control next to density, 2) label = "Sampling (view only)", 3) slider with hover numeric ticks, 4) presets: 1%, 5%, 10% buttons with 44px targets, 5) ghost p95 dashed under 5% with accessible pattern + tooltip, 6) help link inline.
Sam: I'll update the mock and add keyboard interactions doc.
Olga: I'll write the microcopy variants and pair with PM for wording approval.
Jess: I'll add aria labels and request review from accessibility team.
Anu: Thanks — can we aim for a review demo in the design sync on Friday?
Mike: Friday works.
DesignBot: Reminder: design sync calendar invite sent for Friday 10:00am. :bell:
Anu: Perfect, thanks everyone.
